events.title: Sharad Purnima - Akshar Jayanti
paragraphs: Celebrate the Ashwin full moon and Gunatitanand Swami’s birth anniversary with spiritual talks and devotional singing.

events.title: Diwali Chopda Pujan
paragraphs: Light Beyond Lamps — a festival of lights, community & togetherness.
Mahaprasad: 12–1 PM. Chopda Pujan: 1:30 PM. Kids’ Chopda Pujan: 1:45 PM.
Everyone welcome at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, 3620 N Black Canyon Hwy, Phoenix, AZ 85017.

events.title: Grand Annakut
paragraphs: Rajbhog Arti: 12 PM. Arti every hour. Darshan: 12–6 PM.
Exhibition & cultural performances: 1–5 PM. Kids’ Diwali Celebration with free carnival games: 1–5 PM.
Shayona Cafe hot food stalls: 1–5 PM. Free food for all.
Everyone welcome at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, 3620 N Black Canyon Hwy, Phoenix, AZ 85017.

events.title: Pramukh Swami Maharaj Jayanti - Mahila (Ladies) Celebration
paragraphs: A women-led cultural celebration for women, honoring Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s example of spirituality and selfless service.

events.title: Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Birthday Celebration
paragraphs: Honor Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s birthday and his lifelong guidance, care for individuals, spirituality, and service.
